query:
SELECT 
  ei.id,
  ei.expenseId,
  ei.installmentNumber,
  ei.amount,
  ei.dueDate,
  ei.status,
  e.description,
  e.paymentMethod,
  p.name as supplierName
FROM expenseInstallments ei
JOIN expenses e ON ei.expenseId = e.id
LEFT JOIN partners p ON e.supplierId = p.id
WHERE e.status = 'ATIVA'
ORDER BY ei.dueDate DESC
LIMIT 20;
